note: Frame coords are the 512x512 frame. pivot = the fist's grip point (where a handle passes through the curled fingers). angle = degrees a straight, handle-down tool (head up) must be rotated about its grip to sit in the fist: 0 = handle straight down / head up, positive = clockwise. fist = [x, y, w, h] crop box around the fist to redraw on top of the tool so the fingers wrap the handle. Frames: 0 idle, 1 raise, 2 strike, 3 follow-through; ~120 ms each. Clerk frames share pip-swing's canvas, scale and foot line; fists are within 4 px of pip-swing's.
